title: pCoMole: Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing with Discrete Flows
abstract: arXiv:2610.01663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Biomolecular therapeutics often start from known sequences and require targeted editing to improve multiple properties while satisfying hard biochemical and manufacturability constraints. However, existing generative methods do not jointly support multi-objective optimization, hard feasibility, and sequence editing in discrete, variable-length biological spaces. In this work, we introduce Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing (pCoMole), a framework built on discrete flow matching that steers a pre-trained Edit Flow toward user-specified preferences while enforcing terminal feasibility. pCoMole defines a feasibility-gated terminal distribution using an augmented Tchebycheff utility and realizes the resulting preference tilt through a Doob-h transform of the underlying edit process. To make this construction practical, we approximate the required harmonic function using short Monte Carlo rollouts over candidate edits, yielding an efficient g

translated_title: pCoMole：基于离散流的帕累托约束分子编辑
translated_abstract: 生物分子疗法通常从已知序列出发，需要进行靶向编辑，以便在满足严格的生化和可制造性硬约束的同时改进多种性质。然而，现有的生成方法无法在离散、可变长度的生物空间中同时支持多目标优化、硬可行性约束和序列编辑。在这项工作中，我们提出了帕累托约束分子编辑框架pCoMole，该框架构建于离散流匹配之上，能够将预训练的Edit Flow引导至用户指定的偏好方向，同时强制保证终端可行性。pCoMole利用增广的Tchebycheff效用来定义一个带可行性门控的终端分布，并通过底层编辑过程的Doob-h变换来实现由此产生的偏好倾斜。为了使这一构造切实可行，我们通过对候选编辑进行短蒙特卡洛展开来近似所需的调和函数，从而实现高效的……
tldr: 提出了基于离散流匹配的帕累托约束分子编辑框架pCoMole，通过增广Tchebycheff效用和Doob-h变换，在满足硬生化可行性约束的同时，对可变长度生物序列实现面向用户偏好的多目标优化编辑。
en_tdlr: pCoMole is a Pareto-constrained molecule editing framework built on discrete flow matching, which steers a pre-trained edit flow toward user-specified preferences via an augmented Tchebycheff utility and Doob-h transform while enforcing hard biochemical feasibility in variable-length discrete biological spaces.
